'''Ludin''' is [[Aiel]] belonging to the ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.

== Activities ==
Ludin is part of a group of Aiel led by [[Birgitte Silverbow]]. The group carry out guerrilla tactics in [[Braem Wood]] on smaller groups of [[Trollocs]] that are meandering through it. A larger group of Trollocs appears and Birgitte decides to leave that one alone.

== Trivia ==
* Ludin is named for Nils Loodin, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
